name: George O'Brien
bio: A Representative from Illinois; born in Chicago, Ill., June 17, 1917; attended St. Ignatius Grammar School and Loyola Academy, Chicago, Ill.; A.B., Northwestern University, Evanston, Ill., 1939; J.D., Yale Law School, New Haven, Conn., 1947; United States Air Force, Eighth and Twelfth Air Force, 1941-1945, attained the rank of lieutenant colonel; admitted to the Illinois bar in 1947; commenced practice in Chicago; member, Will County, Ill., Board of Supervisors, 1956-1964; Legislative Advisory Committee to Northeastern Illinois Planning Commission, 1970-1971; member of the Illinois state house of representatives, 1970-1971; elected as a Republican to the Ninety-third and to the six succeeding Congresses and served until his death on July 17, 1986 (January 3, 1973-July 17, 1986); died on July 17, 1986, in Bethesda, Md.; interment in Resurrection Cemetery, Lockport, Ill.
